skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced English language proficiency (vocabulary, reading, and writing skills) at B2 level according to the European Framework of Reference for Languages, equivalent to IELTS 5.5-6.0.
Demonstrate the ability to read and comprehend texts at B2 level according to the European Framework of Reference for Languages, equivalent to IELTS 5.5-6.0.
Produce academic essays and summaries at B2 level according to the European Framework of Reference for Languages, equivalent to IELTS 5.5-6.0.
Apply critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate information from various sources.
Work effectively in groups and pairs to solve reading and writing tasks.
Develop independent learning habits and self-assessment skills to enhance reading and writing abilities.
Manage time effectively to complete reading and writing tasks.
Use digital tools for reading and writing tasks.
Communicate effectively in English, both in written and oral forms.
Solve problems related to reading and writing tasks.
